page.overview:
What is Araburutake?

Brute Bonnet is an anthropomorphic and slightly saurian, plump-bodied mushroom-like Pokémon that appears to be an ancient relative of Amoonguss. Like Amoonguss, it is primarily cream-colored. Its cap has six sharp spikes poking upward, and resembles the design and color of a Poké Ball; it has two thin arms with the same pattern as its head that serve as large shield-like "hands" that it always upholds. Hanging down from its mushroom cap is a drape of translucent bright-green moss that partially covers its eyes. Like many Paradox Pokémon, it has yellow eyes with slit black pupils and magenta eyelids. Its underside is brown; it has a plump belly, four stumpy legs, and a long tail resembling that of a dinosaur. Its rounded dark-pink mouth has sharp fangs.

Despite its large size and menacing looks, Brute Bonnet is described as not being very smart. However, it is a very powerful and savage fighter, even though it possesses a low intellect. It opens and bears its sharp fangs threateningly when facing an opponent, and holds up its arms with large, round hands like shields. Due to the name that it was given, it had a brutish nature.

Brute Bonnet can only have the ability Protosynthesis, which will boost its most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if it is holding a Booster Energy.

Sc; It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon. V; It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.
